_comment: digperiphs #5 proof configuration: the Castalia defaults with the OW0 Dallas/Maxim 1-Wire master instantiated in the MUTEX page sub-slot 7 (peripherals.onewire=true, @0x6700). OW0 has ONE pad: DQ on P4.7 / GPIO31 (DTP3), alt plane AF2, open-drain, rstREN=1 -- the pin-mux-v2 REPLACED-SPREAD-SLOT mechanism (Stage H re-pin, 2026-07-26): DQ takes over the redundant T0CMP1 output-spread copy in that slot, and T0CMP1 stays reachable on its P3.1/GPIO17 AF0 primary, its P2.1/P4.5 AF1 relocations and 26 other spread copies. Because the DQ no longer touches P6.6 this configuration carries the DEFAULT fieldPower=true wiring -- the old onewire/fieldPower hard conflict is gone. The engine rides the free-running MCLK (no LFXT, no generated clocks, no clock on the DQ pad -- DQ is 2-FF synchronized). Enabling it extends the IRQ source list per the A5 GLOBAL VECTOR RULE from 114 to 118: vectors 114/115/116 backfill as IRQB_RSVD114/115/116 (RTC and PWM off), 117 = OW0 (single combined transaction-complete/error source); NUM_EN_WORDS stays 4 (118 <= 128). MmrAddrOW0 + RegSlotOW0* appear in MemoryMap.vhd only when the knob is on. Everything else is default. Prove with: make verify CONFIG=config/castalia_onewire.json
